$comment: The starter canvases: Explore's groups, as ready-made canvases a visitor opens and changes (work order 3, lane A). A starter is a canvas link: src/lib/starters.ts writes each one's charts into the address the canvas page reads (src/lib/canvas.ts), so it opens through the same reading code as any shared canvas and a visitor changes it like one. Each chart is a Build question (config/presets.json, builder) with a chart type (null draws the best fit), a width, and the chart's own settings in the address (settings: a time range, how a grid's cells are counted). title and description are interface words: the lint holds them to config/narrative/rules.json as it does the words of config/canvas.json (no figure, no year, no causal word, no value or label of a reference file). from names the Explore preset a chart stands for, which tests/site/starters.test.ts holds the chart to. A chart a canvas cannot draw as Explore did is left out and its preset stays in config/presets.json. A preset on a dataset that is another one filtered (used_imports) is asked as its base with the filter as a condition (src/lib/presetTitles.ts).
